Marty Parker is a small business owner and supply chain expert at the University of Georgia. He says these import taxes could slow down domestic manufacturing.

“Cars is the biggest one that comes to mind, but all kinds of machines and equipment for manufacturing, for farming, for all kinds of industries are made in Georgia,” said Parker.

[...] Georgia businesses that rely on steel and aluminum will face higher costs after import taxes on these metals were doubled to 50% on Wednesday.

This all comes within a week following a trade court blocking a bulk of President Donald Trump’s sweeping global tariffs. Then, an appeals court decided to keep them in effect while the White House continues to fight the ruling. Both sides have until next week to respond.

## About Vista Metals:

VMC Specialty Alloys LLC (dba Vista Metals Georgia) operates under a licensing agreement with Fontana, CA based Vista Metals LLC. Along with Vista Progressive Metals LLC (a producer of aluminum lithium products), the group of companies are market leaders in the manufacturing of specialty aluminum products supporting aerospace, commercial aircraft, defense, automotive, and general industrial applications. For more information, pleasevisit vistametals.com [...] Vista Metals today announced their investment in a new location to serve the aerospace industry with specialty aluminum products. This new facility, located in Bowling Green, Kentucky, is part of Vista Metals’ long range investment plan, will expand upon Vista Metals’ existing capabilities in California and Georgia, and follows the Spring 2024 planned completion of Vista Metal’s 7th aerospace casthouse in Georgia.
